title: Verified profiles publish Claude assets to the segments they cover, read by ref for the sidebar, with staff takedown

tasks.title: Verified profiles and the staff commands to verify a profile and take an asset down
Publish and unpublish, indexed by segment, and the public ref read API for the sidebar

acs.text: WHEN staff run `npm run verify-profile -- <profile id or @handle> --by <name>` THE SYSTEM SHALL mark that profile verified with the time and who did it; `--off` SHALL remove the mark; a profile that does not exist SHALL exit with an error and change nothing; a verified profile's API answers (`GET /api/v1/profiles/{id}`, `/profiles/me`) SHALL carry `verified: true`, and an unverified one's SHALL have no `verified` field, as before
scenarios: AC-001 staff verify a profile from the command line

acs.text: WHEN the owner of an asset whose person profile is verified posts `POST /api/v1/claude-assets/{assetId}/publish` with an optional `versionId` (the current version by default) THE SYSTEM SHALL make that version the published one and index one row per covered segment (asset, version, segment ref, its section ref, the declared ref and its label), replacing the rows of any version published before; an owner who is not verified SHALL get 403 `asset.not_verified` and nothing changes; anyone else, or a version of another asset, SHALL get 404
scenarios: AC-002 only a verified owner publishes

acs.text: WHEN the owner posts `POST /api/v1/claude-assets/{assetId}/unpublish` THE SYSTEM SHALL clear the published version and remove its rows; saving a new version SHALL leave the published version as it was
scenarios: AC-003 unpublish, and a new version does not republish

acs.text: WHEN anyone asks `GET /api/v1/claude-assets/ref/{ref}` for a section or a segment in Sefaria's normal form THE SYSTEM SHALL answer `{ref, assets: [...]}` with every published, not hidden asset whose author's profile is verified and that covers a segment of that ref, each with `id`, `title`, `description`, `author {name, profileId, verified}`, `anchorRefs` (the covered segments inside the asked ref, in text order), `refs` (the declared refs in normal form), `versionId` and the public `contentUrl`; an unknown ref SHALL answer an empty list; the answer SHALL be cacheable for 60 seconds and carry CORS headers for the origins in `SOCIAL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`
scenarios: AC-004 the ref read API for the sidebar

acs.text: WHEN staff run `npm run asset-takedown -- <asset id>` (or `--restore`) THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the asset hidden (or not): a hidden asset leaves the ref answer, its reads and its content at once, and its owner sees it marked hidden
scenarios: AC-005 staff take an asset down, and restore it

acs.text: WHEN a profile's verification is removed THE SYSTEM SHALL leave its published assets out of the ref answer at once, without changing them, and bring them back if it is verified again
scenarios: AC-006 removing a verification hides at once
